counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要统一团队的技能规范
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce consistent skill standards

howto.what: 点评其他技能时:先加载市场规范;只标记影响实际执行的问题(执行错误、指令冲突、内容冗余),忽略维护便利类意见;不追究编排类或审查类技能缺少禁用标记;不把步骤未点名的工具判为多余。
howto.when: 没有写明具体触发词。作为审查类技能,通常在要求它评审、验收一个技能文件(尤其是项目内技能)时接管。

say.text: 请评审这个技能的规则,只挑会影响实际执行的问题。
say.note: 它会按项目规则过滤意见,只报执行层面的问题。

say.text: 先加载 skills-guide,再检查这个技能的规定。
say.note: 确保按市场约定来审查,避免误报。

say.text: 查一下该技能的 allowed-tools 清单,有没有技能根本用不上的工具。
say.note: 它只标记明显多余的工具,不因步骤没点名而误报。

howto.what_en: Reviewing another skill: loads marketplace conventions; reports only execution-impacting findings (bugs, contradictions, context bloat); ignores missing disable-model-invocation on review skills; won't flag unnamed tools as unused.
howto.when_en: No explicit trigger phrase is given. As a review skill, it kicks in when the user asks Claude to review or approve a skill package, especially a project-local one.

say_en.text: Review this skill and report only issues that affect real execution.
say_en.note: It filters by project rules and reports only execution bugs.

say_en.text: Load skills-guide first, then check this skill's conventions.
say_en.note: Ensures review follows norms and avoids false flags.

say_en.text: Check the allowed-tools list for tools this skill obviously cannot need.
say_en.note: It flags only clearly unnecessary tools, not unnamed ones.
